How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Very difficult to find something affordable. Recommend finding off-campus housing

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Public transport in Dublin is very affordable and also pretty reliable. I lived 30 mins away with bus but it was not a problem because of public transport options. Biking is also an option but somewhat difficult. Not really any designated biking lanes anywhere.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: A surveymonkey is sent out with all available modules where you can rank preferences. You then have to wait for email confirmation which might take a day or two. Your list often have scheduling conflicts so you need to redo them. It is frustrating that schedule information is very hard to find which makes the registration hard since you have to just try until you have no schedule conflicts. Meanwhile time is limited, because room on the modules are filling up, so you might not end up with your preferred modules.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Emails or showing up at the desk on available days.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got none of my preferences first time around but then changed all of my preferences to something else and then I succeeded in getting those.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be quick at the start of registration and try to seek out schedules for the modules you want to avoid issues.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was fairly easy. People are very nice and polite. Sometimes it is hard to engage with local students because they are often very busy with reading or friends. I recommend seeking out other erasmus students.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The politics are somewhat different and some students are more culturally conservative than what I was used to. Try not to assume someone's politics if you want to avoid offending.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The Irish like jokes and pranks and are all in all often very entertaining to be around.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Join a few societies and go to an event atleast once.
Find other erasmus students and ask if they want to eat lunch together
If you have a lot of modules, find out what the learning goals and what the assessments are early and prepare to not get overwhelmed later.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The gym is not free for exchange students

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Being able to face and keep up in a foreign environment in a second language

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Getting to know local Irish students. Much easier to find other erasmus students to hang out with.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
